snippet.title: Running Fable Petite Party -Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Running Fable Petite Party throws you and your friends into 16 fast-paced, friendship-testing mini-games across 3 tabletop arenas. Outsmart, outplay, and out laugh each other in this ultimate party showdown for 1–4 players!
